judgment: Crossing the courtyard, no one seen.
image: So the noble one lets no thought
lines: It is good to hold firm, long.
What it follows, it cannot lift.
splitting the muscles of the back.

notes.name_en: 艮 used as a verb throughout (still the toes, waist, jaws); 'Stilling'. Revised pilot: 'So…' pivot, 利永貞 in new form.
notes.L3: 限 the waist-threshold; 列其夤 spinal muscles split; 厲薰心 danger kept as a verb fuming the heart.
